title: Threads: Parallel Sum and Shared Counter
prompt:
Two small exercises with std::thread.

1. parallel_sum(data: Vec<u64>, n_threads: usize) -> u64
   Split data into (up to) n_threads roughly equal chunks, sum each chunk on its own spawned thread, and add the partial results. Share the data with Arc<Vec<u64>> (or use std::thread::scope). Treat n_threads == 0 as 1. Must work when data is empty or shorter than n_threads.

2. concurrent_count(n_threads: usize, per_thread: usize) -> usize
   Create a counter wrapped in Arc<Mutex<usize>>. Spawn n_threads threads; each increments the counter per_thread times (lock, increment, unlock each time). Join all threads and return the final value.

Example:
  parallel_sum((1..=100).collect(), 4) -> 5050
  concurrent_count(8, 1000) -> 8000
